extraction.Name: Frank Arcoran
extraction.Recorded patent: The fee patent was recorded May 18, 1920 by E. E. Frescoin. No receipt was issued for this patent.
extraction.Buyer: William Lynass for a consideration of $9,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739690 issued; southwest quarter of section 17, township 100, range 76; Frank Arcoran died June 19, 1920; heirs are Jack or John Arcoran and Josephine Arcoran; deed executed by Frank Arcoran dated May 17, 1920 conveying land to William Lynass
